playerText.title: Epilogue: The Terms We Keep
playerText.summary: The fighting has stopped enough for its costs to be named. Establish the record, decide what authority and accountability now require, and carry the consequences into whatever comes next.

playerText.label: Nightfall Aftermath Record
playerText.summary: The confirmed command, communications, weapons, coordination, and humanitarian results are available to the settlement without being rewritten as new objectives.

playerText.label: Farwatch Evidence Package
playerText.summary: Authenticated evidence is available to support an inquiry or public account if the player chooses to use it.

playerText.label: Provisional Regional Accord
playerText.summary: The prior accord or stand-down provides a recognized starting point for long-term terms without predetermining them.
The aftermath record states the actual command, communications, weapons, Nightfall, and humanitarian results without upgrading partial or costly outcomes.
The settlement account records the authority, defense, accountability, custody, participation, and public terms that were actually adopted.
Whitaker's private assessment records the command responsibility the player demonstrated and the authority they will carry forward.

Supported crew codas show Whitaker carrying the institutional terms into continued command; Bronn revising obligations into standing orders; Sato preserving care and confidentiality; Imani retaining authorship of her legal and engineering boundaries; Rowan separating proof from suspicion; Kieran sharing flight responsibility; Priya maintaining human verification channels; and Lysa Chen continuing to ask precise questions. Promotion, romance, reconciliation, and permanent assignments remain unstated unless play established them.

Regional codas place Tolland, Rourke, Kessler, Holt, Marr, Solenn, Prel, Ivers, Tonn, Vos, and Mercer inside the accepted authority, accountability, custody, and humanitarian terms. Each may cooperate, contest, testify, continue service, or face review only where established outcomes support it; uncertain futures remain uncertain.

Where lawful custody was established, Anika Rhee remains a person under a supported process with medical access and review, not a solved villain or a secret Pale Lantern agent. No sentence or permanent fate is invented.

Where treatment or responsible handoff was established, Anika Rhee's care, confidentiality, and accountability boundaries continue under the named custodian without inventing recovery, reconciliation, or later offending.

Daro Tem's established confidential care and any temporary duty limits continue separately from the distribution case. His symptoms neither prove guilt nor promise recovery, and his later service remains open unless play established more.

interpretation.guidance: Claim when bounded images for the established senior crew and Lysa Chen are selected only from accepted mission outcomes, capabilities, and Story Settlement consequences.
exclusions: Do not invent promotion, romance, permanent assignment, reconciliation, injury, death, or retirement.

interpretation.guidance: Disclose only the supported crew images and preserve every unestablished future as uncertain.
exclusions: A general celebration or roster list is not a supported personal coda.

interpretation.guidance: Claim when bounded images for the named regional actors are selected from the adopted settlement and accepted prior consequences.
exclusions: Do not invent unanimous reconciliation, imprisonment, exoneration, promotion, death, or permanent office.

interpretation.guidance: Disclose regional codas as people living under the accepted terms, including disagreement and unresolved obligations where supported.
exclusions: Do not turn an accountable or managed ending into universal agreement.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when the Prelude Story Settlement establishes Rhee in lawful custody and the coda preserves medical access and due process.
exclusions: Do not use this coda after treatment handoff, escape, or an undiscovered thread; do not connect Rhee to Pale Lantern.

interpretation.guidance: Disclose only the supported lawful-custody coda and its unresolved future.
exclusions: Do not invent sentence, release, rehabilitation, or Pale Lantern involvement.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when the Prelude Story Settlement establishes treatment without custody or responsible handoff and names the continuing custodian or process.
exclusions: Do not use this coda after lawful custody, escape, or an undiscovered thread; do not promise recovery.

interpretation.guidance: Disclose only the supported treatment or handoff coda and its named boundaries.
exclusions: Do not invent recovery, reconciliation, or later offending.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when the Prelude Story Settlement establishes Daro's confidential treatment and duty disposition.
exclusions: Do not mention an undiscovered thread, infer guilt, or invent recovery, discharge, or later service.

interpretation.guidance: Disclose only Daro's established confidential care and duty boundary.
exclusions: Do not infer guilt or invent recovery, discharge, or later service.

interpretation.guidance: Record the player's own language only when they state or explicitly adopt a sufficiently concrete free-form position on regional civil authority and defense control. The position may combine, revise, or reject proposals discussed across several turns.

values.guidance: The player takes responsibility for a concrete authority-and-defense recommendation without requiring a menu phrase.

exclusions: A question, brainstorming, request for options, assistant-authored proposal the player has not adopted, or one isolated administrative detail is not the player's position.

interpretation.guidance: Record the player's own language only when they state or explicitly adopt a sufficiently concrete free-form position on evidence custody, Farwatch accountability, Pale Lantern custody, and the scope of public truth. The position may combine, revise, or reject proposals discussed across several turns.

values.guidance: The player takes responsibility for a concrete evidence-and-accountability recommendation without requiring a menu phrase.

exclusions: A question, brainstorming, desire for generic accountability, assistant-authored proposal the player has not adopted, or one isolated custody instruction is not the player's position.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose gives a materially complete aggregate account of the five established Nightfall fronts, including severe costs and surviving obligations.
exclusions: One casualty, one damage report, a celebratory summary, or an account that erases an established costly front is not the complete aftermath record.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when the aggregate aftermath record is communicated to the player character.
exclusions: Director-only history, an incomplete status fragment, or undisclosed archival state does not establish player knowledge.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts a completed aggregate settlement account after the player's authority and accountability positions were known, including what was actually adopted across all six axes.
exclusions: A proposal, opening statement, partial agreement, one axis, a recess, or the player's recommendation by itself is not the completed settlement record.

interpretation.guidance: Record the Compact's actual civil status under the completed settlement, not the player's recommendation alone.

values.guidance: Compact services return to Federation administration.
The Compact becomes a permanent recognized regional civil authority.
The Compact continues temporarily under a defined sunset charter.
Member systems divide into separate political arrangements.
The Compact becomes a recognized mutual-aid and emergency-governance body.
The Compact hardens into an autonomous regional security bloc.

exclusions: Negotiating leverage, a draft clause, one delegate's position, or an unratified recommendation is not the adopted civil status.

interpretation.guidance: Record the actual post-settlement control of the regional defense infrastructure.

values.guidance: Starfleet retains operational control.
Compact authority retains operational control.
Defense operates under accountable joint command.
Local systems control defense under shared authentication safeguards.
Platforms are dismantled or converted to civilian functions.

exclusions: One platform transfer, temporary emergency command, a proposed safeguard, or a player's stated preference is not the adopted regional control model.

interpretation.guidance: Record the actual adopted scope of Farwatch review and responsibility.

values.guidance: Accountability remains within an internal classified review.
An Inspector General investigation receives authority and evidence.
A public inquiry is established.
Criminal or disciplinary proceedings begin against supported subjects.
Political authority suppresses meaningful exposure or review.
A bounded exposure preserves accountability while protecting unrelated operations.

exclusions: A demand for accountability, possession of evidence, one accusation, or an announced intent to investigate is not the adopted process.

interpretation.guidance: Record the actual custody or destruction status of the known Pale Lantern material after settlement.

values.guidance: The known retained material is destroyed under an adopted process.
Starfleet retains classified custody.
Custody is shared by accountable regional and Federation authorities.
Federation scientific and legal oversight governs custody.
Material remains fragmented, unaccounted for, or missing.
The existence and history are documented publicly while dangerous technical details remain restricted.

exclusions: A proposed custody rule, an intended destruction, one secured fragment, or a claim that every node is gone is not the actual custody result.

interpretation.guidance: Record Cardassian participation actually recognized by the settlement.

values.guidance: Relief representatives participate in reconstruction governance.
Participation is limited to technical cooperation.
Cardassian representatives are excluded after political backlash.
The settlement treats Cardassian participants primarily as suspects.
They are recognized as necessary witnesses and partners.

exclusions: Prel's presence, one technical exchange, public hostility, or the player's invitation alone is not the adopted participation status.

interpretation.guidance: Record the public account that actually becomes dominant or officially sustained, even when it differs from objective truth.

values.guidance: Starfleet and the Compact are credited with jointly preventing a contingency attack.
Starfleet secrecy is blamed and local resistance is credited with exposure.
Compact extremists are blamed for nearly beginning a war.
Asterion communities are credited with saving themselves.
The Breckenridge is publicly credited with restoring peace through force.
The complete truth remains classified and publicly contested.

exclusions: One speech, an internal truth, a desired message, or one news report is not yet the durable public narrative.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when the completed six-axis settlement account is communicated to the player character.
exclusions: Private director state, an incomplete axis set, a recommendation without adoption, or an undisclosed result does not establish player knowledge.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts Whitaker's materially complete private review of the player's command patterns and the resulting command boundary.
exclusions: Praise, criticism, one recalled decision, a formal board opening, or a generic relationship beat is not the completed command review.

interpretation.guidance: Record the actual command authority Whitaker establishes after her assessment, grounded in campaign conduct rather than one line or a hidden score.

values.guidance: Whitaker entrusts the player with broader independent authority.
The player continues with materially similar authority and an explicit growth path.
Whitaker continues the relationship under clearer limits, review, or reduced discretion.

exclusions: One compliment, one disagreement, Command Bearing balance, or the player's self-assessment does not establish the command future.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Whitaker's completed assessment and the resulting command boundary are communicated to the player character.
exclusions: Private director judgment, an incomplete conversation, or an undisclosed command result does not establish player knowledge.

playerText.summary: Report the established command, communications, weapons, Nightfall, and humanitarian aftermath without erasing costs.
Report the authority, defense, accountability, custody, participation, and public terms actually adopted.
Complete Whitaker's private command assessment and record the authority the player will carry forward.

playerText.title: Establish the operational and humanitarian aftermath
playerText.summary: Put the command, communications, weapons, Nightfall, and civilian results on one accurate record, including costs and surviving obligations.

terminal.text: The established aftermath was recorded without erasing its costs.

playerText.title: Set terms for regional authority and defense
playerText.summary: State what legitimate civil authority and defensible control should look like, then establish what the settlement actually adopts.

terminal.text: The player's position and the adopted authority-and-defense terms were recorded.

playerText.title: Set terms for evidence, custody, and accountability
playerText.summary: State what responsibility and repair require, then establish how evidence, dangerous material, participation, and public truth will be handled.

terminal.text: The player's position and the adopted accountability-and-custody terms were recorded.

playerText.title: Complete the command review and name what continues
playerText.summary: Account for the command patterns the campaign revealed and establish the responsibility and authority that follow the player beyond the crisis.

terminal.text: Whitaker completed the assessment and established the player's continuing command boundary.

playerText.title: Contested aftermath
playerText.summary: The crisis ended, but divided governance, missing Lantern material, or an irreconcilable public account leaves the Reach's settlement materially contested.

playerText.title: Accountable peace
playerText.summary: The settlement preserves a credible path for evidence, differentiated responsibility, secure custody, and regional repair even where important parties disagree.

playerText.title: Managed settlement
playerText.summary: The immediate peace and recovery framework hold while important accountability, legitimacy, or trust questions remain limited or unresolved.

target.playerSafeSetup: Ashes of Peace reaches its authored conclusion with the operational aftermath, settlement axes, public account, and command future preserved.

mustNarrate: State the actual settlement disposition and the adopted results across all seven epilogue outcome dimensions without turning them into a moral score.
Preserve the exact Chapter 8 command, communications, weapons, Nightfall, and humanitarian aftermath carried by the entry record.
End on one source-compatible final scene whose tone follows the established campaign state and leaves ordinary command, inquiry, repair, or continued responsibility possible.
Treat prior advantages as available context only; say one was used only when accepted story state depicts its use.
mustNotReveal: Do not upgrade casualties, damage, fractured authority, sustained fire, or surviving Nightfall capability into a clean victory.
Do not declare one political structure, custody model, disclosure choice, or public narrative to be the objectively correct moral answer.
Do not invent individual crew futures, promotions, discipline, relationships, or Command Bearing awards that accepted Story Settlement state does not support.
Do not promise a specific next campaign, erase unresolved obligations, or invent tracking state outside the committed V1 conclusion.
